name: search_comments
description: Full-text search over wiki *comments* — the discussion threads people leave on pages (decisions, feedback, questions, @mentions), kept separate from page content. Use this when the user asks what was discussed, decided, asked, or flagged about something, or wants to find a particular comment/thread. For the page content itself, use `search_wiki` instead. Returns matches with `doc_path`, `thread_root_id`, a short `snippet`, and a `link` that opens the page focused on that thread. Results are limited to comments the user can read.

query.description: Plain keywords, e.g. "oncall rotation cadence" or a person's name to find mentions of them.
